extension.description: Generate new prompt-derived files from one or more Explorer files using OpenAI-compatible APIs.
command.generateFiles.title: Generate New Files from Prompt...
command.configureProvider.title: Configure Model Provider...
command.openSettings.title: Open Settings
command.openProviderJson.title: Open Provider JSON Configuration
configuration.title: Prompt File Generator
config.providers.description: Model provider profiles in JSON. Run 'Prompt File Generator: Open Provider JSON Configuration' to add the default example to User Settings JSON and edit it directly. API keys are stored in VS Code SecretStorage and are never written here.
config.providers.baseUrl.description: The OpenAI Chat Completions API base URL. Supports api.openai.com, https://api.openai.com, localhost:11434, a complete /v1 URL, or a complete /chat/completions URL.
config.providers.maxTokensParameter.desc: The request field this provider uses to limit maximum output.
config.providers.headers.description: Optional custom request headers. Use ${apiKey} to reference the key in SecretStorage, for example {"api-key": "${apiKey}"}.
config.activeProvider.description: The ID of the default model provider profile. The default example is openai.
config.maxInputCharacters.description: The maximum number of characters sent from each source file. Files over this limit are skipped instead of silently truncated.
config.maxOutputTokens.description: The maximum output tokens for each generation request.
config.temperature.description: Generation randomness. Lower values are better for deterministic file transformations.
config.concurrency.description: The number of concurrent model-provider requests during batch generation.
config.fileNameTemplate.description: The generated filename template. Variables: ${name} is the source basename, ${tag} is the short prompt tag, and ${ext} is the source extension. Example: A.translate-en.ai.ts.
